entry.title: new projects in development: games • Head over Heels
entry.content:
I've been working on this for a little while. It's a M128 port of the isometric classic Head over Heels:
It's not a game I'm overly familiar with but my wife played it loads on the Amstrad PCW and it's one of her favourites.

It's based on a disassembly of the unofficial Plus4 port although I've also been using the C64 version (which the Plus4 version was based on) to identify which areas need changing to run on the Master. I have made some use of AI to help with identifying differences between the two versions.

This is still at a very early stage - I haven't sorted out all of the keyboard mapping yet and it's currently using mode 4. It'll probably stay like this for a while but I'd really like to get it running in mode 1 using the graphics from the Amstrad version.

Also, the Plus4 version has no music or sound but Negative Charge has already done a wonderful job of converting the SID tunes for me.
